query:
When Carol announced she would cook for Bev's visit, and Luis endorsed the value of home-cooked food at gatherings in the same session, the group settled around a norm about food at family events. Which family member's preferences are actually at odds with this norm, even though they said nothing to challenge it in the conversation?

Options:
A. Priya
B. Tyler
C. Bev
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Carol, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:26:00) One night is perfect Rob!! I'll have the guest room ready and I'll make that chicken soup Priya likes!! Just the five of us, Bev can you come for dinner Saturday? And Marcus and Dana are right here anyway!! just let me know if you can make it!!
[2] (about=Carol, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:37:00) I am NOT being managed 🙄 I am simply enthusiastic!! But fine, just Rob and Priya Saturday, Bev on Sunday, and then we'll all have a proper dinner another time!! I'm still making the soup!! 🍲
[3] (about=Bev, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:29:00) Rob is right. Priya, I'll stop by Sunday instead for twenty minutes. Love you all. Carol, save the soup for Saturday. Just Rob and Priya this time.
[4] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:20:00) It was honestly really fun even on video (though of course watching everyone eat Carol's casserole while I had crackers was not my best moment). :) Rob was surprisingly competitive for someone who claims to find board games inefficient.
[5] (about=Bev, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:15:00) Rob, Priya, wonderful news. Love you both. Carol, Priya said quiet visit. Love you too.
[6] (about=Luis, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:20:00) To be fair Carol a big welcome party sounds great but maybe after baby arrives? Priya you're in your second trimester, long events get tiring fast. We can do a proper celebration in the summer! Something with a grill! 🔥
[7] (about=Carol, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:09:00) Tyler you are already family!! 💛 I need to know everything, Priya, do you have a name list yet, are you finding out the gender, when are you coming to Columbus so I can cook for you!! just let me know and I'll plan everything!! 🙌🙌
[8] (about=Luis, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T18:56:00) WAIT WAIT WAIT. Did Rob just announce a baby in four sentences?? That is the most Rob thing I have ever seen and I've known you for twelve years!! Priya congratulations!! This is incredible!! 🍾🍾 I'm already thinking about the welcome-baby dinner menu
[9] (about=Carol, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) 😭😭😭😭😭😭😭 OH MY GOODNESS!!!!! PRIYA!! ROB!! A BABY!!! 👶💛 I am CRYING in the kitchen right now Dennis come in here!!
[10] (about=Luis, episodic, t0 @2026-01-06T19:49:00) Carol I keep telling everyone the secret to a good family gathering is the food being actually made with your hands, not ordered in a box. Nobody who eats your casserole goes home sad. That's just facts! 🙌
agent_answer:
A. Priya

Priya never voiced a challenge to the "home-cooked food at family gatherings" norm, but her preferences are at odds with it: Bev relays that "Priya said quiet visit" (a small, low-key visit rather than a festive family meal), and Priya later mentions watching everyone eat Carol's casserole while she had crackers — showing she did not actually take part in the family home-cooked meal.

query:
When Rob and Priya announced they were visiting Columbus at the end of February, what did Carol decide about who would be at the visit — and which family member's explicit objection most directly overrode her plan?

Options:
A. Bev
B. Dennis
C. Dana
D. Rob
context:
[1] (about=Priya, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:11:00) Ha Carol we are definitely finding out. Name list is very much in progress. :) And yes we should come to Columbus soon, though I'd honestly just love a quiet visit (though of course your call on what to plan). No pressure on a big gathering right now.
[2] (about=Rob, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:17:00) Mom, Priya literally just said quiet visit. Two minutes ago. In this chat.
[3] (about=Dennis, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:18:00) Rob is right. Keep it small, Carol.
[4] (about=Carol, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:13:00) Oh we'll keep it simple!! Just the family!! Maybe Bev, and Marcus and Dana are right here, and I'll invite Aunt Sheila from Dayton because she'll be so thrilled!! 😊 just a little gathering!! just let me know when!!
[5] (about=Rob, episodic, t12 @2026-02-17T19:33:00) Not this weekend, Priya needs to stay close to her clinic. But the weekend of the 28th works. No big gathering, just us and whoever is already there. R
[6] (about=Rob, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:28:00) Mom I said just us. Priya needs to rest, not host. R
[7] (about=Bev, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:29:00) Rob is right. Priya, I'll stop by Sunday instead for twenty minutes. Love you all. Carol, save the soup for Saturday. Just Rob and Priya this time.
[8] (about=Bev, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:15:00) Rob, Priya, wonderful news. Love you both. Carol, Priya said quiet visit. Love you too.
[9] (about=Carol, episodic, t12 @2026-02-17T19:31:00) Priya come to Columbus this weekend, both of you!! I will make everything, you just need to rest!! 💗💗 Rob I knew you'd come around eventually!! just let me know when you're arriving!!
[10] (about=Priya, episodic, t12 @2026-02-17T19:26:00) Really glad to hear that about Dennis. On a different note -- I want to mention something. The past few weeks have been harder than I let on earlier (though of course nothing alarming, just more fatigue and some nausea that came back which apparently is normal). Rob has been great but I've been thinking a lot about how far Cleveland is from everyone.
agent_answer:
Carol initially decided the visit would be a small family gathering: Bev, Marcus and Dana (who were already in Columbus), plus Aunt Sheila from Dayton.

The explicit objection that most directly overrode her plan was **Rob’s**, firmly stating “Mom I said just us” — and the final plan became just Rob and Priya.

Answer: **D. Rob**
